agentView.description: An agent account this PDS created with at.hailey.cocoon.createAgent, as its principal sees it.

principal.description: The account the agent acts for: the one that created it.

status.description: active: it can sign in and write. deactivated: the account was deactivated without being revoked. revoked: its principal revoked it with at.hailey.cocoon.revokeAgent; this is final. takendown: the PDS's operator took it down. When more than one applies, takendown wins, then revoked.

endorsement.description: The principal's link.ident.endorsement of the agent, when it exists in the principal's repo. Absent means the agent-of declaration is unconfirmed (https://ident.link).
